findings.title: Node forbids the pod's sysctl
findings.cause: the pod sets sysctl net.core.somaxconn, which is not on the kubelet's allowlist on node kd-faults-control-plane (its safe set plus --allowed-unsafe-sysctls), so the kubelet rejects the pod (SysctlForbidden)

evidence.what: pod status is Failed, reason SysctlForbidden
evidence.detail: Pod was rejected: forbidden sysctl: "net.core.somaxconn" not allowlisted

findings.fix: Drop net.core.somaxconn from securityContext.sysctls, or allow it on the nodes that should run the pod (kubelet --allowed-unsafe-sysctls=net.core.somaxconn, then a nodeSelector or taint to keep the pod there); Pod Security baseline also refuses unsafe sysctls.
